text: 十几岁的高中男生精力旺盛之时，对一个女字都能产生兴奋。
en: When a teenage high-school boy is brimming with energy, he can grow excited even at the mere character for 'woman'.

text: 到了20多岁的时候，即使没有真人，对墙上挂的女性海报，不管里面的人是阿姨还是姐姐，也能充满幻想。
en: By the time he reaches his twenties, even with no real person there, he can be full of fantasy about a female poster on the wall, whether the person in it is an auntie or an older sister.

text: 到了30多岁的时候，如果没有之前积累的感情，那对陌生异性的追求已经不再主动，都是被动等别人介绍，而且只有遇到同龄或者比自己更小的女性，才会答应去见一面。
en: By his thirties, if he has not accumulated any feelings beforehand, he is no longer proactive in pursuing strangers of the opposite sex; he simply waits passively for others to make introductions, and will only agree to meet a woman his own age or younger than himself.

text: 再到了40多岁的时候，若这个男人还是单身，那就只有20多岁的妹妹，才能让自己回想当年书生意气的辉煌时刻。
en: And by his forties, if this man is still single, then only a twenty-something younger woman can make him recall the glorious, spirited days of his youth as a student.

text: 来个30岁的，拜拜了您嘞。
en: A thirty-year-old shows up? Cheerio, off you go.

text: 来个40岁的，走你。
en: A forty-year-old shows up? Beat it.

text: 为什么40岁男普遍不考虑40岁女？
en: Why do forty-year-old men generally not consider forty-year-old women?

text: 因为40岁男的生理机能下降，40岁女无法使他产生兴趣。
en: Because a forty-year-old man's physiological functions decline, and a forty-year-old woman can no longer arouse his interest.

text: 40岁女也应该是一样的。
en: The same should hold for forty-year-old women.

text: 知乎感情类、男女类的问题，很多回答总是扭扭捏捏，我都不想看了，就不能直白一点吗。
en: On Zhihu, for questions about relationships and the sexes, so many answers are forever timid and evasive that I don't even want to read them—can't they just be more straightforward?

text: 40岁男直接去找20岁女，40岁女直接去找20岁男，找得到就找，找不到就不找。
en: Forty-year-old men go straight to twenty-year-old women; forty-year-old women go straight to twenty-year-old men. If you can find one, go for it; if not, don't.

text: 人生最长也就80年，按现在的食品卫生、空气质量和工作强度，能活到70多岁已经算不错的了。
en: Life is at longest some eighty years; given today's food hygiene, air quality, and work intensity, reaching your seventies already counts as not bad.

text: 满打满算你还有30年，过去40多年都没解决得了的事情，未来30年以你的个人魅力还能解决得到吗？
en: Even counting generously, you have only thirty years left. Something you failed to resolve across the past forty-odd years—could you still resolve it in the next thirty with your personal charm?

text: 因为男女双方思想不一样。
en: Because men and women think differently.

text: 按男的思想，刘强东娶了奶茶妹。
en: By the man's logic, Qiangdong Liu married the Milk Tea Girl.

text: 按女的思想，刘强东应该娶董明珠。
en: By the woman's logic, Qiangdong Liu should have married Mingzhu Dong.

text: 很多女性50岁就能退休。
en: Many women can retire at fifty.

text: 那么你娶一个差10年退休的女孩子，是指望她帮你带孙子吗？
en: So when you marry a girl who is ten years from retirement, are you expecting her to help you look after your grandson?

text: 哦，你这个令人讨厌的土拨鼠
en: Oh, you annoying groundhog.

text: “彼此势均力敌”
en: “Each side is evenly matched”

text: “配你绰绰有余”.......
en: “More than enough for you”.......

text: 之类的话术，是相亲市场研究出来麻痹男性的。
en: Phrases of this sort are tactics the matchmaking market devised to numb men.

text: 真实的情况是，四十岁男性的比较对象从来不是四十岁女性。
en: The real situation is that a forty-year-old man's object of comparison was never the forty-year-old woman.

text: 他只要战胜别的男性，就能娶到想娶的女性。
en: He only needs to defeat other men to marry the woman he wishes to marry.

text: 同样，四十岁的女性希望获得爱情，需要比较的，也不是男性，而是别的女性。
en: Likewise, when a forty-year-old woman hopes to find love, the one she must compare herself with is not the man but other women.

text: 原始社会也好，动物世界也好，求偶不都是同性竞争吗？
en: Whether in primitive society or the animal world, isn't courtship always same-sex competition?

text: 难不成猴王要找个女猴王？
en: Surely the monkey king isn't going to go looking for a female monkey king?

text: 蚁后要找个蚁国王？
en: The ant queen is going to find an ant king?

text: 因为两性的核心资源不同，月入3000的25岁女性，也不会考虑月入3000的25岁男性。
en: Because the core resources of the two sexes differ, even a twenty-five-year-old woman earning 3,000 a month would not consider a twenty-five-year-old man earning 3,000 a month.

text: 相亲市场是功利且赤裸裸的，不用讲什么政治正确，一切都看资源匹配。
en: The matchmaking market is utilitarian and naked to the bone; there is no need to talk of political correctness—everything comes down to resource matching.

text: 在这个社会上，钱对男人有多残忍，年龄对女人就有多残忍。
en: In this society, money is as cruel to men as age is to women.

text: 不同的是，一个月入3000没房没车的男人，大多数是不敢进相亲市场的，因为他们知道自己在雄性竞争中败下阵来，知道即便参加相亲也会遭受白眼，不如先赚钱。
en: The difference is that most men earning 3,000 a month with no house and no car dare not enter the matchmaking market, because they know they have been beaten in male competition, know that even if they join the matchmaking they will be met with dirty looks, and would rather make money first.

text: 但女性对于年龄红利的感知，往往是后知后觉的，有一些清醒的，能意识到颜值红利只有短短十几年，需要在最高点变现。
en: But women's awareness of the age dividend tends to come late; a few who are clear-eyed realise that the looks dividend lasts only a short dozen years or so and must be cashed in at its peak.

text: 她们会提前布局，要么是作为职场优势“颜值+另一优势”获取资源，哪怕做个财经自媒体都好涨粉；要么就作为婚恋红利，在适当的年纪找个家境好的或者潜力股，让自己后半生有保底的安稳。
en: They plan ahead: either they use their looks as a workplace advantage—'looks plus another strength'—to acquire resources, and even running a finance self-media account helps them gain followers; or they treat it as a marriage dividend, finding someone from a good family or a man with prospects at the right age, so as to secure a stable fallback for the rest of their lives.

text: 但对于不清醒的，这种红利逐渐丧失的感觉，就很残忍很残忍。
en: But for those who are not clear-eyed, the feeling of this dividend gradually slipping away is cruelly, cruelly harsh.

text: 很多女性会迷失在颜值红利期的特权中，以为一生都会如此，毕竟只要长得好看，就会自动刷新男人嘘寒问暖，解决工作上乃至人生中的各种问题。
en: Many women lose themselves in the privileges of the looks-dividend period, believing life will always be this way, for as long as they are attractive, men will automatically keep up a constant stream of attentive care, solving all sorts of problems at work and even in life itself.

text: 她们没意识到这种潇洒并非生命体验本身，而是在一直透支红利。
en: They do not realise that this ease and freedom is not life experience itself, but a constant overdraft on the dividend.

text: 再次重申，相亲市场功利且赤裸裸，别扯什么三观契合灵魂共鸣，也不聊什么女性主义，物化和主体性，这个市场就是很看男人的钱，女人的颜值和生育。
en: To reiterate, the matchmaking market is utilitarian and naked: don't drag in talk of aligned values and soul resonance, nor discuss feminism, objectification, and subjectivity. This market simply cares about men's money and women's looks and fertility.

text: 要么就做好准备潇洒一辈子，想要个稳定的婚姻就提前布局，不要认为年龄红利能伴随自己一生，等到40岁，胶原蛋白流失皮肤松弛，那些红利会被收回。
en: Either prepare to live freely your whole life, or if you want a stable marriage, plan ahead. Do not think the age dividend can stay with you for life; by the time you are forty, with collagen lost and skin slack, those dividends will be reclaimed.

text: 到了这个时候，如果发现除了脸蛋身材之外的东西，诸如资源人脉能力认知一个都拿不出手，那种落差感是极强的。
en: When that time comes, if you find that apart from your face and figure you have nothing presentable to offer—no resources, no network, no ability, no insight—the sense of disparity will be acute indeed.

text: 很多女性认为这是社会对大龄女性的恶意，其实只是年龄红利的回收。
en: Many women believe this is society's malice towards older women; in truth it is merely the reclaiming of the age dividend.

text: 但其实在相亲市场上，女性依然是有优势的，一个40岁月薪3000没房没车的女人依然有选择的权力，只是要降低标准，而40岁月薪3000没房没车的男人就只能自嘲“社会底层”，别说找对象，就连说话都不敢太大声。
en: But in fact, in the matchmaking market, women still hold the advantage: a forty-year-old woman earning 3,000 a month with no house and no car still has the power to choose, only she must lower her standards; whereas a forty-year-old man earning 3,000 a month with no house and no car can only mock himself as “the bottom of society”—not only can he not find a partner, he dare not even speak too loudly.

text: 所以对于有颜值红利的女性而言，必须要提前建仓，想好走雌竞还是雄竞路线，
en: So for women who possess the looks dividend, they must build their position early and decide whether to take the female-competition or male-competition route;

text: 选雌竞就边练情商边筛选，上嫁或找个潜力股；
en: Choose female competition and you hone your emotional intelligence while screening, marrying up or finding a man with prospects;

text: 选雄竞就把颜值当职场亮点，早点搞钱搞资源，以后情感市场上就很自由，很有钱你可以找帅气的小弟弟，条件一般自给自足也可以抛却经济考量找志趣相投的。
en: Choose male competition and treat your looks as a workplace strength, make money and gather resources early, and you will be very free in the relationship market later: if you are very wealthy you can find a handsome younger man; if your circumstances are merely average and you are self-sufficient, you can also set aside economic considerations and find someone kindred in interest.

text: 不至于像题目中一样，40岁才反应过来，想用颜值价值生育价值换后半生安稳，发现在市场中早已没有自己的位置。
en: You will not end up as in the question, only realising at forty that you wished to trade your looks and fertility for stability in later life, only to find you long since have no place in the market.

text: 以上
en: That is all.

text: 我是宏桑，一个心理咨询师，
en: I am Hong Sang, a psychological counsellor,

en: For relationship counselling you can add me on WeChat: hongsanghit

en: The original answer was deleted, so I am writing it again.

text: 有一件事，可能在知识的盲区里。
en: There is one thing that may sit in a blind spot of knowledge.

text: 40岁的女人总是端着，这也不愿，那也不愿，或者说了好久才象征性的用嘴唇碰一下就不干了。
en: A forty-year-old woman always holds herself aloof—unwilling to do this, unwilling to do that—or only after much coaxing will she symbolically touch with her lips and then stop.

text: 20岁的、10几岁的女孩都乐于尝试，即使眼泪呛出来了也会继续。
en: Twenty-year-old and teenage girls are eager to experiment, and will keep going even when tears well up.

text: 如果你是一个40岁的男人，你会怎么选？
en: If you were a forty-year-old man, which would you choose?

text: 现在真实的情况是…
en: The real situation now is…

text: 40岁的女人觉得40岁的男人没卵用。
en: A forty-year-old woman thinks a forty-year-old man is utterly useless.

text: 40岁的男人觉得40岁的女人也没卵用。
en: A forty-year-old man thinks a forty-year-old woman is just as useless.

text: 男性很专一，只喜欢18岁的。
en: Men are very single-minded; they only like eighteen-year-olds.

text: 女性也很专一，只喜欢有钱的。
en: Women are likewise very single-minded; they only like those with money.

text: 按照这个标准理解问题基本就没啥错了。
en: Understanding the matter by this standard, you will basically not go wrong.
